newsitem.title: USA: Bill Cosby taking paternity blood test, lawyer says.
newsitem.headline: Bill Cosby taking paternity blood test, lawyer says.

text.p: A lawyer for Bill Cosby said Monday that the entertainer was taking a DNA blood test to determine if he was the father of the woman who last week was convicted of trying to extort $40 million from him.

"As we speak, Mr Cosby is having blood drawn for a DNA test," lawyer Jack Schmitt said on Geraldo Rivera's show on the CNBC cable network. He also challenged Autumn Jackson and her mother to take similar tests to determine once and for all if Cosby was the young woman's father.

On the same programme, Autumn Jackson's lawyer Robert Baum vowed to speak to his client as soon as possible to see if she was willing to take the test and press a paternity suit against the man she said she grew up believing was her father.
Jackson, 22, was convicted last Friday in New York of threatening to go to a tabloid newspaper with her story unless Cosby paid her the $40 million.
Schmitt said he was confident the test would show Cosby was not the father, even though the comic actor has admitted having an affair with the woman's mother and had paid for her education.
The judge in the federal extortion case ruled out any discussion of Cosby's paternity as irrelevant. Autumn Jackson faces up to 12 years in prison when she is sentenced later this year.
